items.stem: In Azure DevOps, which syntax in a commit message links it to an Azure Boards work item?

options.rationale: Correct: mentioning AB#{id} links the commit to that work item.
Incorrect: @ is used for mentions, not work-item linking.
Incorrect: ref: is not the Azure Boards linking syntax.
Incorrect: // is a comment marker, not a linking syntax.

items.explanation: Correct: mentioning AB#{id} links the commit to that work item.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about Azure Boards and Repos integration are true? (Select TWO.)

options.text: You can create a Git branch directly from a work item
options.rationale: Correct: a branch can be created from the Development control of a work item.

options.text: A branch policy can require linked work items on a pull request
options.rationale: Correct: the Check for linked work items policy enforces this.
Incorrect: Azure Repos supports Git repositories.

options.text: Work items cannot be linked to pull requests
options.rationale: Incorrect: work items can link to branches, commits, and pull requests.

items.explanation: Correct: a branch can be created from the Development control of a work item.

items.stem: What does a pull request enable in Azure Repos?

options.text: Merging changes and starting a code review
options.rationale: Correct: a pull request merges changes and starts a code review.
Incorrect: that is unrelated to pull requests.
Incorrect: PRs do not create VMs.
Incorrect: PRs do not issue certificates.

items.explanation: Correct: a pull request merges changes and starts a code review.
